description:
The DMR Trailstar frame is now available in a limited-edition titanium version to celebrate the company's 30-year anniversary – the original Trailstar was our first ever mountain bike frame.
The new Trailstar Ti comes with a long, low and stable geometry, featuring a slack head angle, steep seat tube and long reach numbers. The new frame is sized by reach and is also designed to be used with a dropper post – and for the first time, the Trailstar Ti has been designed to accommodate 29” wheels and optimised for a 140mm fork.
Titanium frame construction means a lighter frame, unbeatable quality and durability, and a unique riding feel that only titanium can give you.
The horizontally adjustable dropouts allow you to fine-tune the Trailstar Ti's chainstay length according to your riding style, and it comes with the added benefit of single-speed capability. The GW Switch Lever Thru Axles come with a clean and simple design and can be fitted or removed using a 6mm hex key.
When choosing the size of the Trailstar Ti, consider your riding style and fit preferences instead of your height. Externally routed cables make servicing the bike easy, and it allows the use of a full-length outer cable to ensure that your Trailstar Ti runs smoothly even during the UK winter.
Ride a Trailstar Ti hardtail and you won’t go back.
